description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Sweet Sorrow (0~2), removed after using Apex Sweet Sorrow two times

description.text: Increases Apex Sweet Sorrow level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Galuf]

description.text: Keeps track of Apex Sweet Sorrow level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Galuf]
